## Summarize

Replace this example with your own summary if you choose a different question.

```{r}
bmi_summary <- nhanes |>
  filter(!is.na(BMI), !is.na(IncomeGroup)) |>
  group_by(IncomeGroup) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_bmi = mean(BMI),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

bmi_summary
```

## Function

```{r}
mean_with_n <- function(x) {
  tibble(
    n = sum(!is.na(x)),
    mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

mean_with_n(nhanes$BMI)
```

```{r}
nhanes <- readr::read_csv(
  "examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

nhanes_clean <- nhanes |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(BMI), !is.na(IncomeGroup)) |>
  dplyr::select(IncomeGroup, BMI) |>
  dplyr::rename(income_group = IncomeGroup, bmi = BMI)




## Save Output

```{r}
dir.create("assignments/assignment02-r-with-ai/submission/output", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(bmi_summary, "assignments/assignment02-r-with-ai/submission/output/summary_table.csv")
```
